title: NOPE!! Cheap, broken, and overpriced!
text: NOPE!! Cheap, broken, and overpriced!. It arrived bent and I threw it in the trash because I didn’t think it could be fixed. My daughter worked on it a while, bent it back, and it’s decent, but you shouldn’t have to do that with a new product. I also thought it was a porcelain white but it’s actually a shimmery white that looks like cheap plastic, so that kind of stinks, too. Would not recommend this product, especially for the price.
